attempt_3_official_azure_cn_page.note: The official Azure China virtual-machine pricing page contains no NCads A100 v4 entry of any size. A case-insensitive scan of the full 7,865,382-byte page for 'NC96ads', 'NC24ads', 'NC48ads' and 'A100' returned zero matches. The Azure China retail price API returned Count=0 for armSkuName eq 'Standard_NC96ads_A100_v4' in every region. The A100 GPU SKU is therefore not publicly priced in Mooncake and is quote-on-request after quota approval.

egress.note: Model bytes were pulled INTO chinaeast3 from a public source, which is inbound and unbilled. No blob upload and no cross-region copy had occurred at observation time, so no egress meter was triggered. A deliberate topology choice avoided a cross-region transfer: the GPU host in chinaeast3 fetched checkpoints directly rather than staging them through the chinanorth3 CPU host. Final check: 19 blobs totalling 611,828 bytes were written into chinaeast3 from the same-region GPU host, so no cross-region or internet egress meter was triggered by this invocation. Final: 47 blobs totalling 117,045,201,262 bytes were written from the GPU host in chinaeast3 into a storage account in chinaeast3, so the upload is same-region and triggers no egress meter.

marketplace_charges.note: Both VMs report an empty 'plan' object, so neither image carries a marketplace or third-party software charge. Note that cpuserver runs an Ubuntu Pro image; Ubuntu Pro can carry a separate charge on some offers, but no plan object is attached to this VM.
